answer_1.quote: We introduce a method that leverages known performance on similar high-resource domains to predict performance change on a new low-resource domain for Text Summarization ...

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE, BERTScore, FActScore, and GPT-4-based evaluations for coherence, relevance, and other subjective aspects, representing the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4o-mini as a judge to do a prompt-based evaluation of all generated summaries against Coherence, Readability, Relevance, and Fluency.

answer_4.quote: We recruited eight annotators from a local university ... Each annotator was asked to assign a score between -1 and +1, reflecting the quality of a summary relative to a provided reference. They also provided a recommendation label (Fine-tuned Summary preferred, ICL Summary preferred, zero-shot summary preferred).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored generated summaries on a -1 to +1 quality scale relative to a reference and selected a preference label among fine-tuned, ICL, or zero-shot summaries.
